what: Validating data inline: validate_data() and asserts
title: orchrd: Workflow Orchestration for R
text: Quick, inline assertions fail loudly clear messages. replacement full framework – meant catch obvious problems early. assert_schema(data, cols) – required columns must exist. assert_range(data, col, min, max) – numeric column within bounds. assert_no_na(data, cols) – missing values named columns. Wrap rule formula (~ assert_*()) validate_data() can collect failures instead stopping first.

what: React to files: fire_on() and the on_*() verbs
title: orchrd: Workflow Orchestration for R
text: fire_on(event, path, action, ...) binds action filesystem event. action either function (event, path) one-sided formula ~ expr .path .event bound. Event verbs: on_arrive() (created), on_change() (modified),on_leave() (deleted), on_rename() (renamed). returns watcher ID invisibly. Low-level watch_dir() / watch_file() sit underneath.
